messages:
Maya (AE): Customer MacroBank POC ask: Private deploy with single /28 allowlist, SD-WAN to AWS, and they saw truncated LLM responses. Can we avoid touching their route tables?
Omar (Solutions Eng): Two recommended patterns: PrivateLink (interface endpoint) or deploy our connector in their VPC. PrivateLink minimizes route changes (ENIs auto-created). Connector-in-VPC preserves client src IP.
Liam (NetOps): Important: PrivateLink ENIs are in-customer subnets so app->ENI sees requester IP at VPC level, but our control-plane egress still uses Redwood public EIPs unless they host connector themselves. If procurement only allows a /28, we must provide the EIP set to allow.
Priya (NetSec): MTU/truncation likely SD-WAN IPsec MSS issue. Ask their network team for path MTU; common fix is MSS clamping on the connector or SD-WAN.
Omar (Solutions Eng): Quick connector workaround: enable TCP MSS clamping (iptables/TCPMSS) or run an ALB with gRPC support in front of the connector.
Liam (NetOps): Minimal SG examples to paste into their runbook:
# allow app to endpoint ENI
aws ec2 authorize-security-group-ingress --group-id sg-app --protocol tcp --port 443 --cidr 10.0.5.0/24
# allow connector outbound to control plane
aws ec2 authorize-security-group-egress --group-id sg-connector --protocol tcp --port 443 --cidr 198.51.100.0/28

Priya (NetSec): Short security blurb for their questionnaire:
"Redwood Private supports: (A) Connector-in-customer-VPC: retains client source IP and requires outbound TLS (443) to Redwood control-plane EIPs. (B) PrivateLink via interface endpoints: creates ENIs in customer subnets; firewall changes limited to SG updates. No inbound internet exposure required."
Maya (AE): Procurement also wants cost delta vs Dedicated and one-time infra fees. Omar, can you give a POC estimate?
Omar (Solutions Eng): Estimate: one-time onboarding + monthly connector fee. Small single-AZ POC ~1.2x hosted per-token cost for the trial; HA multi-AZ adds infra line items. I'll follow up with formal numbers.
infra-bot: POC created: redwood-poc-macrobank-1 (pb-99aabb). Link: https://internal.redwood/pocs/pb-99aabb
Maya (AE): Thanks. Liam, please post exact EIP /28 and recommended healthcheck TTLs when ready. Priya, can you own compliance follow-up on packet capture/log retention?
Liam (NetOps): Will post EIPs + TTL recs in ~1hr.
Priya (NetSec): On it.
Maya (AE): I'll send the SG snippets and security blurb to MacroBank and request SD-WAN MTU details.
